name: Electrified Entrance

stealth.details: (trained) to spot the runes etched into the door's frame

disable: DC 26 Acrobatics check (trained) to jump through the door before the runes trigger, DC 28 Thievery check (expert) to scratch out the runes, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 24) to counteract the runes

items.name: Sizzle
items.text:
A creature moves through the doorway

---
Effect Arcs of lightning flash across the threshold. The triggering creature takes 4d8+18 electricity damage (DC 23 basic Reflex save save). On a failure, the creature is also Dazzled for 1 minute. On a critical failure, the creature is Blinded for 1 minute and then dazzled for an additional minute.

text: Magical runes electrocute anyone who crosses the door's threshold.
